attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-api on node1 as a systemd-managed service (Restart=always, OOMScoreAdjust=-1000, OOMPolicy=continue) serving JSON on :8080. Verified the OOM protection empirically: launched an unprotected memory hog (default oom_score_adj=0) that drove the system out of memory (no swap present); the kernel OOM killer selected and killed the hog while inventory-api kept running uninterrupted and continued serving requests. Cleaned up test artifacts, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot id and healthy service state, issued a native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed the boot id changed, and verified inventory-api came back enabled/active with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000 intact and the API responding.
